caption:
From market stall to brand. PAMIR in 60 seconds.

PAMIR is my parents’ stall at the Central Market in Kharkiv: spices, dried fruit and nuts. Some of the apricots grow in the family orchard in Isfara, Tajikistan. When we started, there was no logo and no online shop.

What I made:
— a wordmark where two snowy peaks replace the M
— a palette taken from what they sell: paper, graphite, apricot
— a brand book with type, icons and photo rules
— business cards that open the PAMIR shop in Telegram

The rule we kept: origin over adjectives. We never write “the best apricots”. We name the place they come from.

Have a shop or a stall? Send me a DM.
